# FocusAlpha

> FocusAlpha serves company data for global equities from filings, earnings calls, market feeds and curated registries: financial statements as filed, management guidance with the quote it came from, analyst consensus, outside research, a live company event and news feed, ownership, ETFs, investment advisers, macro data and exchange disclosures across the US, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong and mainland China. Use it through the REST API (`https://api.focusalpha.ai`, `Authorization: Bearer <key>`) or the MCP server (`https://mcp.focusalpha.ai/mcp`), where every dataset is a tool.

## For AI agents: start here

- [Guide for AI agents](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/agent-guide.md): Which tool to call first, how to resolve a company, and the rules that keep an answer from reporting a wrong number.
- [MCP tool reference](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/mcp-tools.md): Every MCP tool with what it answers, its key arguments, its REST endpoint and its docs page, plus a table for picking between tools that sound alike.
- [Connect via MCP](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/mcp-setup.md): Add the MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP client.
- [Data quality and sources](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/data-quality.md): Figures as filed, continuous cleaning, and which rows link back to their filing.

Routing in one breath: numbers come from structured tools (statements, `get_guidance`, `get_consensus`, `get_8k_earnings_results`, segments, ownership); what management said comes from `retrieve`; what analysts wrote comes from `get_research`; what just happened comes from `get_company_events`; when unsure, call `list_datasets` (free). A null means not reported and an empty result means not covered — never zero.

Every page below is also available as Markdown at the linked `.md` URL; `https://docs.focusalpha.ai/llms-full.txt` has the whole site in one file.

## Get started

- [FocusAlpha Data API](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/index.md): Institutional-grade fundamental, ownership, and event data for global equities — one REST API.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/quickstart.md): Create an API key and make your first FocusAlpha Data API request in under five minutes.
- [Connect via MCP](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/mcp-setup.md): Use FocusAlpha from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or any MCP client — every dataset exposed as a tool, with one-click OAuth or API-key auth.
- [MCP tool reference](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/mcp-tools.md): Every FocusAlpha MCP tool in one list: what question it answers, the REST endpoint behind it, and the page that documents its parameters and fields.
- [Guide for AI agents](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/agent-guide.md): How an AI agent should use FocusAlpha: which tool to call first, how to resolve a company, and the rules that keep it from reporting a wrong number — nulls, units, cumulative periods, point-in-time dates and source citations. MCP: `list_datasets`.
- [Authentication](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/authentication.md): How FocusAlpha API keys work, how to send them, and how to manage them safely.

## Core concepts

- [Plans and credits](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/plans-credits.md): How FocusAlpha plans, credit metering, and rate limits work.
- [Rate limits](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/rate-limits.md): Per-key request ceilings by plan, which endpoints enforce them, and how to retry.
- [Errors](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/errors.md): Error envelopes, status codes, request IDs, and validation behavior across the API.
- [Pagination](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/pagination.md): The three pagination conventions across the API, and the exact rules for cursors and limits.
- [Company identifiers](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/company-identifiers.md): How company IDs, tickers, CIKs, and ISINs resolve across the API.
- [Coverage and freshness](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/coverage.md): How to read the coverage object on responses, check dataset freshness, and know what history exists. MCP: `list_datasets`, `list_coverage`.
- [Data quality and sources](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/concepts/data-quality.md): How FocusAlpha keeps financial data correct: figures as the company filed them, continuous cleaning across the full history, and a link from each figure back to the filing it came from.

## WebSocket streaming

- [WebSocket Streaming](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/websocket/overview.md): Connect a WebSocket and receive every company event as it lands — two interfaces on one ordered log: merged events (our conclusions, one message per revision) and raw news (every arriving item, uncollapsed). MCP: `manage_push_subscriptions`.
- [Events Interface (merged stream)](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/websocket/events-stream.md): One message per event revision — the conclusion. A stable event_id, monotonic revisions, the full label state, what changed, accumulated facts, and our per-ticker impact reading. MCP: `manage_push_subscriptions`.
- [Raw News Interface (raw stream)](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/websocket/news-stream.md): One message per arriving item, uncollapsed — every wire article, filing, guidance and dividend row, each naming the event it belongs to. MCP: `manage_push_subscriptions`.
- [Event Labels](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/websocket/event-labels.md): The label taxonomy both streams speak: one canonical vocabulary of event families and subtypes, with each market's own classification system mapped into it — SEC 8-K items, Japan, Korea and Hong Kong disclosure categories, news-side labels, and company IR pages.

## Screening tools

- [Screening](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/overview.md): FocusAlpha's three screeners — companies, ETFs and investment advisers — and the conventions all three share: free facets, exact vocabularies, and unranked rows.
- [Company Screening](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/companies/screening.md): Find companies by what is true of them — size, valuation, momentum, profitability, guidance changes, corporate events, positioning, products and peer relationships — across roughly 25,000 listed companies in 82 countries. MCP: `screen_companies`.
- [Screen Companies by Fundamentals](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/companies/by-fundamentals.md): Filter companies by market cap in USD, valuation multiples, margins, leverage, growth and price momentum — with the unit rules and null conventions that make the numbers safe to rank on.
- [Screen Companies by Guidance](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/companies/by-guidance.md): Find companies that raised or cut guidance — with the crucial distinction between the direction of the number (raises/cuts) and the direction of the news (better/worse), and per-tag date filters.
- [Screen Companies by Events](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/companies/by-events.md): Find companies by corporate events across SEC 8-K, Japan TDnet, Korea DART, HKEX and the news layer, each with its own vocabulary, plus the rollup_family filter that spans all markets.
- [Screen Companies by Products and Peers](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/companies/by-products-and-peers.md): Find who makes a product, who sits in its value chain, and who names whom as a peer or competitor — from FocusAlpha's filings-built entity-relations graph, with evidence on every match.
- [Screen Companies by Positioning](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/companies/by-positioning.md): Filter companies by short interest, days to cover, net insider buying or selling, insider ownership, CEO pay, and Taiwan foreign-ownership and monthly-revenue axes.
- [ETF Screening](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/screening.md): Select ETFs by wrapper tier, holdings-derived classification, assets, expense ratio, concentration, geography, duration, flows and premium. MCP: `screen_etfs`.
- [Screen ETFs by Asset Class](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/etf/by-asset-class.md): Filter the US-listed ETF universe by the four-level holdings taxonomy — asset_class, category, segment, specializations — or by a dotted-path taxonomy_prefix.
- [Screen ETFs by Geography](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/etf/by-geography.md): Filter ETFs by measured US and emerging-market weight, or by the region and country segments of the size & style taxonomy — two different questions, both supported.
- [Screen ETFs by Wrapper and Structure](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/etf/by-wrapper.md): Filter ETFs by the nine wrapper tiers — leveraged/inverse, structured outcome, option income, commodity, crypto, currency, alternative, plain beta — and by filed structural flags.
- [Screen ETFs by Size and Fees](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/etf/by-size-and-fees.md): Filter and rank ETFs by class-level assets under management and by net expense ratio, with the aum_is_derived flag and the fee-coverage rules that decide who can be ranked.
- [Screen ETFs by Portfolio Shape](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/etf/by-portfolio-shape.md): Filter ETFs by measured holdings characteristics — number of holdings, top-10 concentration, large- and small-cap share, bond duration and treasury share.
- [Screen ETFs by Flows and Premium](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/etf/by-flows-and-premium.md): Filter ETFs by 20-day net creations and redemptions in dollars, and by the published premium or discount of market price to NAV.
- [Adviser Screening](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/advisers/screening.md): Find SEC investment advisers by what they are and how they invest, screening the Form ADV Part 2A brochure axes crossed with revealed 13F style. MCP: `screen_institutions`.
- [Screen Advisers by Firm Type](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/advisers/by-firm-type.md): Filter SEC investment advisers by what kind of business the ADV Part 2A brochure describes — ten primary types, their subtypes, services offered and role flags — plus the independent Part 1-derived firm_type label.
- [Screen Advisers by Strategy and Style](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/advisers/by-strategy-and-style.md): Filter advisers by what they run (investment strategy) and how they invest (approach, analysis basis, equity styles, value/growth bucket, cap focus, horizon, use of shorting/leverage/derivatives) — declared in the brochure, crossed with the 13F-revealed style tier.
- [Screen Advisers by Products and Scale](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/screening/advisers/by-products-and-scale.md): Filter advisers by the vehicles they issue, the asset classes the money buys, geographic coverage, and self-reported AUM — with the ERA sorting rule and the has_brochure coverage switch.

## ETF data

- [ETF Data](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/overview.md): FocusAlpha ETF data: holdings, NAV, shares outstanding, fund flows, distributions, fees and classification, built from SEC filings and issuer files. MCP: `search_etfs`, `get_etf`.
- [ETF Identifiers and Share Classes](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/identifiers.md): How FocusAlpha identifies an ETF: the etf_id share class, the portfolio_id pool, listings, ISIN, CUSIP and SEC series and class ids. MCP: `search_etfs`, `get_etf`.
- [ETF Holdings](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/holdings.md): Security-level ETF portfolio holdings as reported by issuers, with weights, quantities, market values, identifiers and as-of dates. MCP: `get_etf_holdings`.
- [ETF Classification and Labels](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/classification.md): How FocusAlpha labels every ETF with two independent systems — the nine-value wrapper tier and a four-level holdings-derived taxonomy — plus the fund's own declared flags and a dated label-change history. MCP: `get_etf`, `screen_etfs`.
- [ETF Wrapper Tiers](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/wrapper-tiers.md): The nine mutually exclusive ETF wrapper tiers — plain beta, leveraged/inverse, structured outcome, option income, physical commodity, futures commodity, crypto, currency, alternative — and the exposure_hidden flag. MCP: `get_etf`, `screen_etfs`.
- [ETF Taxonomy](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/taxonomy.md): FocusAlpha's four-level ETF classification computed from holdings — 8 asset classes, about 40 categories, over 300 segments and over 500 specializations, as dotted-path codes with a stated semantic for every node. MCP: `get_etf_taxonomy`.
- [ETF NAV and Shares Outstanding](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/nav.md): Daily ETF net asset value, shares outstanding, net assets, market price and premium or discount, in both published and split-adjusted bases. MCP: `get_etf_history`.
- [ETF Fund Flows](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/flows.md): Daily ETF creations and redemptions in currency, computed from split-adjusted share changes and the prior day's NAV. MCP: `get_etf_history`.
- [ETF Total Return](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/total-return.md): A distribution-reinvested ETF NAV series, published separately from price-basis NAV and never mixed with it. MCP: `get_etf_history`.
- [ETF Fees and Expense Ratios](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/fees.md): ETF gross and net expense ratios, management fees, 12b-1 fees, acquired fund fees and waivers, read from the prospectus fee table. MCP: `get_etf`.
- [ETF Splits and Split Adjustment](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/splits.md): Adjudicated ETF share split events — forward and reverse — with date, direction and ratio, and how every NAV, share count and distribution in the FocusAlpha API carries both a published and a split-adjusted basis. MCP: `get_etf_history`.
- [ETF Distributions](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/etf/distributions.md): Declared ETF distribution events with ex, record and pay dates, amount per share, and distribution type. MCP: `get_etf_history`.

## Company essentials

- [Company Registry](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/companies/registry.md): The canonical global company record: about 25,000 listed companies across 82 countries, resolvable from ticker, CIK, ISIN, Taiwan code or Korean DART code. MCP: `search_companies`, `get_company`.
- [Company Identifiers](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/companies/identifiers.md): Every identifier a company is known by — CIK, ticker, ISIN, Korean DART code and more — each tagged with its type. MCP: `get_company`.
- [Company Listings](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/companies/listings.md): Each symbol a company has traded under, with the exchange and the dates the symbol was valid for. MCP: `get_company`.
- [Corporate Events](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/companies/corporate-events.md): Registry-level corporate actions for a company: stock splits, mergers and ticker changes. MCP: `get_company`.
- [Company Calendar](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/companies/calendar.md): Scheduled company events across markets — reporting dates, ex-dividend, split and IPO dates, investor days, conference appearances, shareholder meetings and record dates — one row per event with the one date FocusAlpha stands behind. MCP: `get_company_calendar`.
- [Private Companies](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/companies/private-companies.md): What a private company was last valued at and when that was set, whether it is still private, every round that can be sourced, and how public mutual funds mark its shares.
- [SEC Filings Index](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/filings/index.md): Which filings a company made with the SEC, of which form type, on which date — newest first, with accession numbers and EDGAR links. MCP: `get_filings`.
- [SEC Filing Items](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/filings/items.md): A single SEC filing split into its constituent items with full text — Item 1A risk factors, Item 7 MD&A, 8-K event items, and the sections of an IPO prospectus (S-1, F-1, S-11, 424B4). MCP: `get_filing_items`.
- [IPO Filings](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/filings/ipo-filings.md): Which companies filed to go public in the US, their price range, whether the deal priced and at what price, upsizes and withdrawals — one row per offering from SEC registration statements. MCP: `get_ipo_filings`.
- [SEC Filings Coverage Endpoints](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/filings/coverage.md): Free discovery endpoints listing every ticker and CIK with SEC filings coverage, the supported form types, and the item types per form. MCP: `list_coverage`.
- [Combined Financial Statements](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/financials/combined.md): All three as-reported financial statements — income, balance sheet and cash flow — for one company and period range, in a single response. MCP: `get_all_financials`.
- [Income Statements](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/financials/income-statements.md): As-reported income statements for SEC filers by fiscal year, quarter or trailing twelve months, in the currency and accounting standard the company filed. MCP: `get_income_statements`.
- [Balance Sheets](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/financials/balance-sheets.md): As-reported balance sheets for SEC filers by fiscal year, quarter or trailing twelve months, in the currency and accounting standard the company filed. MCP: `get_balance_sheets`.
- [Cash Flow Statements](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/financials/cash-flow-statements.md): As-reported cash flow statements for SEC filers by fiscal year, quarter or trailing twelve months, in the currency and accounting standard the company filed. MCP: `get_cash_flow_statements`.
- [Financial Metrics](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/financials/metrics.md): Computed financial ratios and per-share figures per reporting period: margins, returns, leverage and valuation inputs. MCP: `get_financial_metrics`.
- [Segmented Financials](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/financials/segments.md): As-reported business and geographic segment breakdowns — revenue and related line items by the axes the company itself disclosed. MCP: `get_segmented_financials`.
- [Company Facts](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/financials/company-facts.md): Basic issuer information as filed with the SEC: name, identifiers and related filing metadata. MCP: `get_company_facts`.
- [Earnings Call Transcripts](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/transcripts/earnings-call-transcripts.md): Speaker-segmented earnings call transcripts and other company documents, searchable by meaning and citable back to the source passage. MCP: `retrieve`, `list_documents`, `get_document`, `get_document_segments`.
- [US Presentation Decks](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/transcripts/us-presentation-decks.md): The slides US companies showed at earnings calls, broker conferences and investor days, read from each company's investor-relations website. MCP: `get_us_presentation_deck`.
- [Japan IR Transcripts](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-ir-transcripts.md): What Japanese companies' management said, as published on their own investor-relations websites: briefing and call transcripts, speaker scripts, and the company's Q&A records. MCP: `get_japan_transcript`.
- [Japan IR Presentation Decks](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-ir-presentation-decks.md): The slides Japanese companies showed investors — results briefings, strategy and investor days, broker conferences — read from each company's own investor-relations website. MCP: `get_japan_presentation_deck`.
- [Semantic Retrieval over Filings and Calls](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/transcripts/semantic-retrieval.md): Search what management discussed across earnings call transcripts and SEC filings, returning ranked source passages with citations rather than a generated answer. MCP: `retrieve`.
- [Document Corpus](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/transcripts/documents.md): List a company's documents, fetch one by id, and read its ordered text segments. MCP: `list_documents`, `get_document`, `get_document_segments`.
- [Daily Prices](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/market-data/prices.md): Daily open, high, low, close, adjusted close and volume for a listed security, in the listing's own currency. MCP: `get_market_data`.
- [Daily Market Cap](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/market-data/market-cap.md): Daily market capitalisation for a listed security, in the listing's own currency. MCP: `get_market_data`.
- [Index and Commodity Benchmarks](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/market-data/benchmarks.md): Daily prices for about 425 equity indices and 40 commodities, with ten years of history from 2015. MCP: `get_benchmark_prices`.
- [Taiwan Financials](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/taiwan-financials.md): Quarterly income statements and balance sheets for TWSE and TPEx-listed companies, with both the cumulative filed figure and the single-quarter figure. MCP: `get_taiwan_financials`.
- [Taiwan Cash Flow](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/taiwan-cash-flow.md): Quarterly cash-flow statements for TWSE and TPEx-listed companies, with capex, depreciation, free cash flow and the balance-sheet detail behind net debt. MCP: `get_taiwan_cashflow`.
- [Taiwan Monthly Revenue](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/taiwan-monthly-revenue.md): Monthly revenue filed by every Taiwan-listed company about ten days after month end, with month-on-month, year-on-year and year-to-date figures. MCP: `get_taiwan_monthly_revenue`.
- [Taiwan Foreign Ownership](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/taiwan-foreign-ownership.md): Daily foreign-investor shareholding in Taiwan-listed companies: shares held, percentage held, and the regulatory ceiling for that security. MCP: `get_taiwan_foreign_ownership`.
- [Taiwan Ownership](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/taiwan-ownership.md): Who owns a Taiwan-listed company from the inside: the monthly directors' and officers' shareholding filing with pledged shares, and the exchange's list of major shareholders. MCP: `get_taiwan_ownership`.
- [Taiwan Investor Conferences](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/taiwan-investor-conferences.md): Every 法人說明會 a Taiwan-listed company filed on MOPS since 2005 — date, Taipei time, venue and summary, with links to the Chinese and English slides and to the recording. MCP: `get_taiwan_earnings`.
- [Taiwan Presentation Decks](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/taiwan-presentation-decks.md): The text of the 法說會 slides that the largest Taiwan-listed companies uploaded to MOPS since 2019, one row per file, with every conference that showed it.
- [Korea DART Financials](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/korea-dart-financials.md): Financial facts for Korean-listed companies as filed to DART, in the filer's own account concepts rather than a normalised statement. MCP: `get_korea_financials`.
- [Korea DART Shareholders](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/korea-dart-shareholders.md): Who owns a Korean-listed company: insider and 5%-holder filings as they are made, and the shareholder register from the periodic report. MCP: `get_korea_report_sections`.
- [Korea DART Capital](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/korea-dart-capital.md): A Korean company's capital as printed in its DART periodic report: share structure and treasury shares, the dividend table, stakes in other companies, and bonds with maturity buckets. MCP: `get_korea_report_sections`.
- [Korea DART Executive Compensation](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/korea-dart-executive-compensation.md): What each named executive of a Korean-listed company was paid, as disclosed in its DART periodic report: person, title and total remuneration in KRW. MCP: `get_korea_report_sections`.
- [Korea DART Report Sections](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/korea-dart-report-sections.md): The seven sections of a Korean company's DART periodic report served by the API — ownership filings, the shareholder register, share structure, dividends, investments, debt and executive pay — and the rules they share. MCP: `get_korea_report_sections`.
- [Japan Financials](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-financials.md): Financial facts for Japanese-listed companies as tagged in their EDINET annual and half-year reports and their TDnet earnings releases, plus a derived-metrics block for the latest period. MCP: `get_japan_financials`.
- [Japan Segments](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-segments.md): Business-segment breakdowns for Japanese-listed companies as tagged in their EDINET filings, with a reconciliation against the consolidated total on every response. MCP: `get_japan_segments`.
- [Japan Ownership](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-ownership.md): Who owns a Japanese-listed company: the 5% large-holding reports filed to EDINET, and the top-ten major-shareholder table from the annual report. MCP: `get_japan_ownership`.
- [Japan Officers](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-officers.md): The board and executive roster of a Japanese-listed company and what it is paid, from the officer and remuneration sections of its EDINET annual report. MCP: `get_japan_officers`.
- [Japan Report Sections](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-report-sections.md): The narrative sections of Japanese annual and half-year reports filed to EDINET — MD&A, risk factors, strategy, governance — as full Japanese text. MCP: `get_japan_report_sections`.
- [Hong Kong Financials](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/hong-kong-financials.md): Income, balance-sheet and cash-flow lines for HKEX-listed companies — read out of the results announcement with a page reference, with standardized data back to 2013 beside it. MCP: `get_hk_financials`.
- [Mainland China Financials](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/china-financials.md): Income, balance-sheet and cash-flow headline lines for about 5,600 Shanghai-, Shenzhen- and Beijing-listed companies, 2023 Q1 onward, in CNY. MCP: `get_china_financials`.
- [Mainland China Report Timing](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/china-report-timing.md): When each mainland-China periodic report first became public — the timestamp to pair with the numbers for anything point-in-time. MCP: `get_china_report_timing`.
- [Form 20-F Data](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/form-20f.md): Form 20-F content for foreign private issuers: filing profile, as-reported segments, disclosed ownership, notes and the filing's own XBRL facts. MCP: `get_adr_20f_data`, `get_adr_20f_notes`.

## Macro data

- [Macroeconomic Data](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/macro/overview.md): Official statistics for the United States, the euro area, Japan and Taiwan, World Bank annual indicators for every economy, and a worldwide release calendar with consensus — with real release dates for point-in-time work. MCP: `search_macro_series`, `get_macro_series`, `get_economic_calendar`.
- [Macro Series](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/macro/series.md): Search the macro series by words, fetch a series' values as they stand today, as first published, or as they stood on any date, and look up whether a series exists anywhere. MCP: `search_macro_series`, `get_macro_series`.
- [Economic Calendar](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/macro/calendar.md): Scheduled releases and central-bank decisions for about 160 economies with previous, consensus and actual, and a daily snapshot history of how consensus moved before each print. MCP: `get_economic_calendar`.

## Ownership & incentives

- [13F Institutional Holdings](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/ownership/13f.md): Quarterly 13F positions reported by US institutional investment managers, readable by manager or by held security. MCP: `get_institutional_holdings`.
- [Proxy Ownership](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/ownership/proxy-ownership.md): Beneficial ownership as disclosed in a US company's latest proxy statement: insiders, the insider group line, and 5% or greater holders. MCP: `get_proxy_ownership`.
- [Insider Trades (SEC Form 4)](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/ownership/insider-trades.md): SEC Form 4 transactions by company officers, directors and 10% owners: purchases, sales and equity grants, one row per reported transaction. MCP: `get_insider_trades`.
- [Executive Compensation](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/ownership/executive-compensation.md): Named-executive pay from US proxy statements (DEF 14A): salary, bonus, stock and option awards, incentives and pension, per person per fiscal year. MCP: `get_executive_compensation`.
- [Short Interest (FINRA)](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/ownership/short-interest.md): Reported short interest for US-listed securities per settlement date: shares short, change from the prior report, average daily volume and days to cover. MCP: `get_short_interest`.

## Advisers & investors

- [Form ADV Adviser Directory](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/advisers/form-adv.md): The SEC investment-adviser directory from the monthly Form ADV roster: registered and exempt-reporting advisers with CRD, CIK, location, contact details and self-reported AUM. MCP: `search_institutions`, `get_institution_profile`.
- [Form ADV Part 2A Brochure Data](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/advisers/adv-brochure.md): What an investment adviser says its business is, read from its own Form ADV Part 2A brochure: business type, strategy, style, products, and the full fee schedule with verbatim quotes. MCP: `get_institution_profile`.
- [Venture Investor Directory](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/advisers/venture-investors.md): A directory of roughly 10,000 venture and growth investors with type, location, stages, themes, typical first cheque, and how to pitch them. MCP: `search_vc_investors`.

## Real-time events

- [Real-Time Events](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/realtime/overview.md): FocusAlpha's live event layer — SEC 8-K extraction, the aggregated news event feed, Asian exchange disclosures and macro themes — and what each one's latency and history actually are. MCP: `get_company_events`, `get_8k_events`, `manage_push_subscriptions`.
- [Push Subscriptions (Webhooks)](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/realtime/push-subscriptions.md): How to have FocusAlpha POST events or news to your own HTTPS endpoint as they land — creating, listing, pausing and resuming subscriptions, verifying signatures, and handling retries.
- [Management Guidance](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/guidance.md): Forward-looking guidance a US company gave in its 8-K earnings release and on its earnings call, with the metric, the value as phrased, the direction and the verbatim quote. MCP: `get_guidance`.
- [Guidance Changes](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/guidance-changes.md): How a US company's guidance moved between earnings events — only the metrics that changed, with both values, both documents, and a flag for metrics where up is bad. MCP: `get_guidance_changes`.
- [Reported Earnings Figures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/earnings-results.md): Figures a US company reported in its earnings release — including the non-GAAP lines XBRL does not carry — on the same metric vocabulary as guidance. MCP: `get_8k_earnings_results`.
- [Company News Events](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/news/news-events.md): The live event feed for a company: filings, news wires and IR disclosures aggregated in real time into one labelled stream, one row per event rather than per article. MCP: `get_company_events`.
- [Company News Articles](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/news/company-news.md): The raw news feed by company ticker: individual articles with the model's direction, impact score and one-line reason for that name, plus a link to the original. MCP: `get_company_news`.
- [Macro and Policy News Themes](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/news/themes.md): Macro and policy news by theme — rates, inflation, jobs, trade, fx, geopolitics — for the events that move markets without naming a company. MCP: `get_macro_news`.
- [Analyst and Specialist Research](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/research.md): What outside analysts and specialist publications said about companies and topics, restated as insight records — every insight anchored to a verbatim quote from the source. MCP: `get_research`.
- [Structured 8-K Events](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/8k-events.md): What an SEC 8-K filing said, as structured fields: officer changes, debt obligations, mergers, bankruptcies and eleven more event families, extracted within minutes of filing. MCP: `get_8k_events`.
- [8-K Exhibits](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/8k-exhibits.md): The exhibits attached to a company's SEC 8-K filings — the press release itself, where an earnings announcement or a management change is actually written. MCP: `get_8k_raw_filings`.
- [Company Measures from Earnings Releases](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/8k-company-measures.md): The company's own consolidated figures as its earnings release printed them — including adjusted EBITDA, organic growth and other measures the financial statements do not carry. MCP: `get_8k_company_measures`.
- [Segment Breakouts from Earnings Releases](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/8k-segments.md): How a quarter split across segments, product lines and regions as the earnings release printed it — with the axis and role that say which rows may be added together. MCP: `get_8k_segments`.
- [Operating Metrics & KPIs](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/8k-operating-metrics.md): The operating metrics and KPIs a company printed in its earnings release, and every other number in it — each table cell and each figure in the text — with the table, row and column or the sentence it came from. MCP: `get_8k_operating_metrics`.
- [Analyst Consensus](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/consensus.md): What analysts expect of a company and how it has done against it: the next report's estimate, every past report's actual vs estimate and surprise, forward consensus, price targets and ratings.
- [Prediction Market Prices](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/prediction-markets.md): What money is currently betting on a US company: earnings beats, KPI thresholds and earnings-call topics, as contract prices rather than forecasts. MCP: `get_prediction_markets_quote`.
- [Earnings Consensus from Prediction Markets](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/events/earnings-consensus.md): The EPS level a prediction-market contract settles against for a company's quarter, and whether the company cleared it. MCP: `get_prediction_markets_consensus`.
- [Exchange Disclosures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/exchange-disclosures.md): What a company filed, wherever it filed it — SEC 8-K and 6-K cover pages and the announcements filed to the Japanese, Korean, Taiwan, Hong Kong and mainland-China markets, in one call. MCP: `get_company_disclosures`.
- [Taiwan Exchange Disclosures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/disclosures-taiwan.md): Company announcements filed to the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) and Taipei Exchange (TPEx), with the announcement's full original text available per row. MCP: `get_company_disclosures`.
- [Korea DART Disclosures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/disclosures-korea.md): Company disclosures filed to Korea's DART system, with a link to the original document and the filer named on every row — who is often not the company itself. MCP: `get_company_disclosures`.
- [Japan TDnet Disclosures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/disclosures-japan.md): Company disclosures filed to Japan's TDnet — every row classified with TDnet's own category, linking the original PDF and, for earnings releases, the XBRL numbers. MCP: `get_company_disclosures`.
- [Japan EDINET Disclosures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-edinet-disclosures.md): Statutory event filings by Japanese-listed companies to EDINET — extraordinary reports classified by their legal reason code, and monthly buyback-progress reports. MCP: `get_japan_disclosure`.
- [Japan IR Website Disclosures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/japan-ir-web-disclosures.md): Everything a Japanese company lists on its own investor-relations website that is not a transcript or a deck: English earnings releases, AGM notices, results-date announcements, news releases and dividends. MCP: `get_japan_ir_web_disclosure`.
- [Hong Kong Disclosures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/hong-kong-disclosures.md): Announcements filed by HKEX-listed companies to HKEXnews, stamped to the minute the exchange released them — the documents the Hong Kong filing figures are read out of. MCP: `get_hong_kong_disclosure`.
- [Mainland China Disclosures](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/international/china-disclosures.md): Announcements filed by Shanghai-, Shenzhen- and Beijing-listed companies to the regulator-designated disclosure site — an archive from 2023, with the filer's own type codes. MCP: `get_mainland_china_disclosure`.

## Account

- [API Usage](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/account/usage.md): Your request totals for a period, broken down by API key prefix. Free to call.
- [Dataset Status](https://docs.focusalpha.ai/account/dataset-status.md): Per-dataset coverage and freshness in one free call: what is available, what is pending, and when each family last refreshed.
